## Why

<!--
The problem, the bug, or the ask — and why it is worth doing now. Link the
issue if there is one: `Closes #123`.

## What

<!--
The approach in a few lines, plus any decision or trade-off a reviewer would

## Verification

<!--
What you ran and what it showed — ideally a test that fails without this

-->
